from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document, including case type and court if available")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: str = Field(description="The type of document, e.g., 民事判决书，行政裁定书，etc.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
